# eBikeQuest

> Find the right e-bike. Know where you can ride it.

Independent research for choosing an e-bike and understanding where it can be ridden. Trail, law, and rider-guide pages are the live record. Brand and model profiles are published only after a source is cited.

## Live
- Home: /
- Safety and classification: /safety
- Guides: /guides
- Trails: /trails
- Laws: /laws

## In research
E-bike, brand, buying-guide, and comparison pages exist as sections. They are omitted from the XML sitemap until a record meets the publication bar. Do not treat an empty section as a catalog.

- E-bikes: /ebikes
- Brands: /brands
- Buying guides: /buying-guides

## Coverage
Trail and law pages currently cover Virginia, Maryland, and Washington DC. Other jurisdictions are not publicly indexed.
